businessProblem: Lakshmi Vilas Bank requires immediate diagnosis of root causes and a highest-priority action plan given capital inadequacy, severe asset-quality deterioration, governance instability, and depositor-confidence fragility, with no concluded rescue capital or merger arrangement as of 16 November 2020.

evidence.finding: Capital ratios below regulatory minimums; bank under RBI Prompt Corrective Action framework
evidence.source: RBI regulatory disclosures and PCA framework application

evidence.finding: Elevated non-performing loans with significant provisioning burden; losses over multiple consecutive quarters
evidence.source: Bank financial disclosures and regulatory reporting

evidence.finding: Prior capital-raise and merger attempts had not concluded in a successful transaction
evidence.source: Public reporting on LVB capital-raise history

evidence.finding: Depositor confidence fragile creating liquidity risk across retail and institutional depositor base
Board-level governance disputes and leadership instability observed over prior period
Non-compliance with capital adequacy and other PCA norms; no concluded rescue or merger arrangement
Bank required credible capital infusion or regulatory-facilitated rescue arrangement to restore confidence

clientContext.size: Mid-size private sector bank with nationwide branch network
clientContext.revenueImpactUrgency: Critical - solvency and depositor-protection risk; immediate regulatory resolution risk
